title: no WARN_ON if provider leaves key_ctx non-NULL on error
description: ioctl_key_import and ioctl_key_generate trust that key_ctx==NULL on provider error per API contract. If a buggy provider sets *key_ctx non-NULL and returns error, framework does module_put(owner) without calling key_free(key_ctx), leaking key material. Same issue in ioctl_init sess_init path. Framework should WARN_ON(key_ctx != NULL) after failed callback and call key_free if non-NULL. Trigger: buggy provider sets *key_ctx = allocated_struct, returns -EINVAL → key material memory leaked.
